title: Custom Party Decorations & Kits in Ticino | VAM Deco
description: Party kits, personalised name gifts, favours and even the cake: everything for your party, coordinated and made to measure in Ticino. Free quote in 24/48h.
heroParagrafi: The party kit, the personalised name gifts, the favours and even the cake. Everything for your party, coordinated and made to measure, crafted in Ticino together with Lisa Details.

No more running around ten different shops. Choose your products, add a themed cake and receive everything coordinated in the same style. We take care of every detail, from a first birthday to a christening, from a baby shower to Christmas.
claimArancione: Everything for your party, all from one place.
whatsappTesto: Hi VAM Deco, I'd like to personalise my party.
beneficiTitolo: A memorable party is built on the details
beneficiIntro: Every item can be personalised with a name, photo, date and theme: choose what you need and receive it coordinated with the rest of the party.

benefici.testo: Everything you need to set up the party in one coordinated kit: decorations, cake toppers, place cards and accessories all in the same theme.
Framed prints, lettering and gifts personalised with the guest of honour's name: handmade details that stay as a keepsake after the party.
Party favours, a sweet table and personalised invitations for births, christenings and birthdays, coordinated with the theme chosen for the event.
Made-to-measure cakes and decorated cookies coordinated with the party, prepared by our partner pastry chef. On quote, with no obligation.
Same theme, same colours and the same care on every piece, cake included: your party looks harmonious from the table to the invitations, and photographs beautifully.
Carefully handcrafted work with DTF printing, made in Ticino: generally ready in 5-10 working days, depending on the request.

fasi.d: The occasion, theme and products for the kit. The cake too, if you like: tell us about your party on WhatsApp or in the form.
Name, photo, date and colours: we prepare the custom design and you approve it before production.
We make everything by hand and with DTF printing in Ticino, generally in 5-10 working days.
Collect it at our premises or have it shipped to your door anywhere in Switzerland, ready to set the scene.

faq.domanda: How far in advance should I order for a party?
faq.risposta: Products are generally ready in 5-10 working days, depending on the request. Ideally, get in touch 2 weeks before the event; for urgent orders ask us anyway, we can often help even at short notice.

faq.domanda: Can I order just a single item?
faq.risposta: Yes: we also make single items, such as a cake topper or a framed name print. No minimum order.

faq.domanda: Do you make the cakes and cookies too?
faq.risposta: Yes: themed cakes coordinated with the party and decorated cookies, prepared by our partner pastry chef. They are requested on quote, with no obligation.

faq.domanda: Do you create the artwork too, or do I have to provide it?
faq.risposta: We create it for you: tell us the theme and we prepare the custom artwork, which you approve before production. If you already have your own file, we check it and use it.
Directly from this page using the form or on WhatsApp, online at shop.vamdeco.ch in the Lisa Details section, or by messaging @lisaa_details on Instagram.

faq.domanda: Do you deliver outside Ticino too?
faq.risposta: Yes, we ship throughout Switzerland. Free collection is available at our premises in Sementina.
